text:
riley_user: Hi team — applied the onboarding promo code I received (ONBOARD-REDWOOD-50) but my hosted account balance still shows $0. I can see a credit on a dedicated instance under our org though. Can someone confirm where the promo landed?

alex_support: Hey @riley_user — sorry about that. Can you paste your org id and the promo code exactly as you received it? Also any screenshots of Billing > Credits page would help.

riley_user: org: org-acme-42, promo: ONBOARD-REDWOOD-50 (email subject: Welcome — 50 credits). Screenshot attached (not in export), but the dedicated pool showing +50 is under tenant id tenant-ded-01. Hosted dashboard (org-acme-42) still 0.

alex_support: Thanks. Tagging billing to look up grant routing: @maria_billing can you check where ONBOARD-REDWOOD-50 was applied?

maria_billing: I can see the grant id. Quick lookup: grant id 0x7f9c3 applied at 2025-11-07T14:02Z. Target: tenant-ded-01, sku: dedicated_basic, attributes: [partner:onboard, campaign:onboard-nov]. It should have routed to hosted_startup for this code. Looks like the routing rule matched dedicated_basic because campaign tag overrides default.

alex_support: Oof. Can we move it to the hosted org tenant? If so, will that restore the hosted credit balance immediately or do we need a reprovision?

maria_billing: We can reassign the grant. Using internal tool: `billingctl transfer-grant --grant 0x7f9c3 --to-org org-acme-42 --to-sku hosted_startup` — doing that now.

eng-billing-bot: billingctl: started transfer job job-9923 for grant 0x7f9c3 -> org-acme-42/hosted_startup

maria_billing: transfer job completed successfully. Grant now attached to org-acme-42, sku hosted_startup. Cache invalidation kicked off for billing cache.

alex_support: @riley_user can you refresh Billing > Credits and confirm? Also you might need to sign out/in for the dashboard to pick up the new balance.

riley_user: Refresh done — I see +$50 on hosted credits now. API calls also reflect credit usage when I hit /v1/usage. Thanks! Quick note: when I tried to create a hosted API key earlier I got an auth error and it said "quota exceeded" which was confusing.

maria_billing: That auth error was likely because the grant was applied to the dedicated tenant which didn't share hosted API quotas. Now that the grant is reassigned it should behave normally. I'll leave a short runbook step for support to check grant target if customers report quota mismatch.

jamie_custsuccess: Following up — filing SUP-6789 to track root cause. Preliminary findings: partner:onboard campaigns with tag campaign:onboard-nov were missing the hosted override in the routing matrix introduced by a config push on 2025-11-07. We'll roll a fix to ensure campaign tags default to hosted_startup unless explicitly targeted to dedicated/private.

alex_support: Great. @riley_user — apologies for the friction. I've added a credit-use summary to your ticket and marked it resolved on our side. If you see any more weirdness (auth errors or credits flipping between pools), ping us and we'll escalate to eng. :thumbsup: 

riley_user: All good for now, thanks everyone :heart:
